name: Springfield
seo_title: Springfield OR Christmas Events for Kids 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Springfield, Oregon for 2026: the Oldest and Coldest parade, Willamalane events, free Santa photos and an Elf musical.
lede: Springfield's season opens with the Oldest and Coldest Christmas parade on December 5, then adds Willamalane's skate party, tea and solstice evening, free Santa photos at Bass Pro Shops, a junior Elf musical, an escape room, and Oakridge and McKenzie River lights and boat parades.
celebrates: Springfield's Christmas season starts with the Springfield Christmas Parade on Saturday, December 5, 2026, which the Oregon Riders Society runs and which is free to watch. Willamalane fills December 19 and 20 with the Ugly Sweater Skate Party at the Bob Keefer Center, the Holiday Tea and the Winter Solstice Celebration at Dorris Ranch. Bass Pro Shops Springfield offers free photos with Santa through Christmas Eve, East Side Baptist Church stages Elf The Musical Jr. on December 11 and 12, and Escape The Room Oregon runs Santa's Workshop through January 10. East of town, the McKenzie River has a bridge lighting on December 5 and a boat parade on December 6.
lastyear: The Oregon Riders Society's parade is the 74th this year, which makes the December 6, 2025 parade the 73rd, and the first Saturday of December appears to be its regular slot. We did not find a published 2025 recap of Willamalane's holiday events or of the Oakridge tree lighting, so this page relies on each host's own 2026 listing, checked on November 26. Dates for the Oregon Riders Society parade come from its website, and the start time comes from a tourism calendar.
facts: The Springfield Christmas Parade calls itself the Oldest and Coldest, and 2026 is its 74th year. The route starts at 21st and Olympic Street, runs down Mohawk Boulevard and ends at Pioneer Parkway and Main Street. Willamalane runs the Bob Keefer Center and Dorris Ranch, where the Holiday Tea and Winter Solstice Celebration are held on December 20. Bass Pro Shops Springfield, at 2800 Gateway Street, is a 58,000 square foot store that opened in May 2011. Leaburg Lake's boat parade is the McKenzie Community Partnership's 3rd annual.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Springfield for Christmas 2026. For more events in the area, see our Eugene page.
traditions: The Oregon Riders Society's Oldest and Coldest parade on December 5, down Mohawk Boulevard, free to watch.
The Ugly Sweater Skate Party on December 19, then the Holiday Tea and Winter Solstice Celebration at Dorris Ranch on December 20.
Free photos with Santa at Bass Pro Shops Springfield from November 8 through December 24.
East Side Baptist Church's one hour musical on December 11 and 12, tickets $6 or $10 for two.
The City of Oakridge lights its tree at 6:30 pm on December 4 during the First Friday Art Walk.
The Belknap Bridge lighting with Santa on a raft on December 5 and the Leaburg Lake boat parade on December 6.

faq: Springfield holds its 74th Christmas parade on December 5, 2026, and Willamalane hosts the Ugly Sweater Skate Party, Holiday Tea and Winter Solstice Celebration on December 19 and 20. Families can also see Santa free at Bass Pro Shops Springfield and catch Elf The Musical Jr. on December 11 and 12.
When is the Springfield Christmas Parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026. The Oregon Riders Society website confirms the date, and the Eugene, Cascades & Coast calendar lists it from 1 to 4 pm.
Is the Springfield Christmas Parade free?
Yes. It is a public parade and free to watch.
Are photos with Santa free in Springfield?
Yes at Bass Pro Shops Springfield, where the company says each family gets a free 4x6 photo and a free video, from November 8 through December 24, with free reservations or walk-ins.
Which Willamalane Christmas events are for kids?

The Ugly Sweater Skate Party on December 19 at the Bob Keefer Center, the Holiday Tea on December 20 at Dorris Ranch, and the Winter Solstice Celebration on December 20 at Dorris Ranch. Prices are on Willamalane's event pages.

Yes. This page also lists the Oakridge tree lighting on December 4, Shred with Santa at Willamette Pass on December 19 and 20, the Belknap Bridge lighting on December 5 and the Leaburg Lake boat parade on December 6.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Springfield for 2026, and here is what he found: 11 family events across Springfield and 3 nearby towns, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 8 (Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops Springfield) through January 10, with Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony in Uptown Oakridge (December 4), Holiday Bridge Lighting Celebration at Belknap Bridge (December 5) and Springfield Christmas Parade (December 5) along the way. New in this update: Santa's Wonderland at Bass Pro Shops Springfield (November 8 to December 24), Santa's Workshop Escape Room at Escape the Room Oregon (November 14 to January 10) and Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony in Uptown Oakridge (December 4). We check every date on the host’s own website, and each listing links straight there. For the whole area, see Christmas events for kids in Eugene.
